boundaries: Exact thread hash and unique session association only; no timing/usage-fingerprint matching.
Official usage is deduplicated by response_id; cumulative usage notifications are not summed.
Transcript deltas are append-order evidence, not exact request context inclusion or per-token attribution.
Cached input is a subset of input; reasoning tokens are a reported output detail, not an additive bucket.
Model default base instructions, per-model paths, retained history and tool/image context can differ despite identical frozen assets/tasks.
Name/description discovery catalogs are not complete outbound tool schemas; actual schema count and bytes are unavailable.
No Available skills heading/personal skills directory in actual developer messages supports skills-not-observed, not proof that includeInstructions flag was false.
No raw prompts, account/email, tool arguments, image URLs, original identifiers or private source paths are exported.
HTTP/WS attempts, logical sampling, usage completions, errors and warmup are separate counters.
